_note: Content for the daily social posts. Beej and naam mantras are copied from our /remedies pages; Navagraha verses are the standard Vyasa Navagraha Stotram. Have a pandit proof-read new entries before they are posted.

surya.name: Surya

tool.label: See which planet period you are running

surya.hook: Career stuck? Working hard but no recognition?
surya.about: Surya rules authority, confidence, health and your standing at work.

variants.text: ॐ ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रौं सः सूर्याय नमः
variants.translit: Om Hraam Hreem Hraum Sah Suryaya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of the Sun, salutations to Surya.

variants.text:
जपाकुसुमसंकाशं काश्यपेयं महाद्युतिम् ।
तमोऽरिं सर्वपापघ्नं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम् ॥
variants.translit:
Japakusuma sankasham kashyapeyam mahadyutim
Tamorim sarvapapaghnam pranato'smi divakaram
variants.meaning: I bow to the Sun, red like the hibiscus flower, son of Kashyapa, of great radiance, the enemy of darkness who destroys all sins.

chandra.name: Chandra
chandra.about: Chandra rules the mind, emotions, sleep and your mother.

variants.text: ॐ श्रां श्रीं श्रौं सः चन्द्राय नमः
variants.translit: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of the Moon, salutations to Chandra.

variants.text:
दधिशङ्खतुषाराभं क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भवम् ।
नमामि शशिनं सोमं शम्भोर्मुकुटभूषणम् ॥
variants.translit:
Dadhi shankha tusharabham kshirodarnava sambhavam
Namami shashinam somam shambhor mukuta bhushanam
variants.meaning: I bow to the Moon, white as curd, conch and snow, born of the ocean of milk, the jewel on Shiva's crown.

mangal.name: Mangal
mangal.hook: Anger, fights at home, debts piling up?
mangal.about: Mangal rules courage, energy, property, debts and conflict.

variants.text: ॐ क्रां क्रीं क्रौं सः भौमाय नमः
variants.translit: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Mars, salutations to Bhauma, the son of the Earth.

variants.text:
धरणीगर्भसम्भूतं विद्युत्कान्तिसमप्रभम् ।
कुमारं शक्तिहस्तं तं मङ्गलं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
variants.translit:
Dharani garbha sambhutam vidyut kanti samaprabham
Kumaram shakti hastam tam mangalam pranamamyaham
variants.meaning: I bow to Mangal, born from the womb of the Earth, shining like lightning, the youth who holds a spear.

budh.name: Budh
budh.hook: Exams, interviews or a big business deal coming up?
budh.about: Budh rules intellect, speech, learning, trade and communication.

variants.text: ॐ ब्रां ब्रीं ब्रौं सः बुधाय नमः
variants.translit: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Mercury, salutations to Budh.

variants.text:
प्रियङ्गुकलिकाश्यामं रूपेणाप्रतिमं बुधम् ।
सौम्यं सौम्यगुणोपेतं तं बुधं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
variants.translit:
Priyangu kalika shyamam rupenapratimam budham
Saumyam saumya gunopetam tam budham pranamamyaham
variants.meaning: I bow to Budh, dark like the priyangu bud, of matchless form, gentle and full of gentle qualities.

brihaspati.name: Brihaspati
brihaspati.hook: Marriage delayed? Waiting for a child or a good teacher?
brihaspati.about: Guru rules wisdom, marriage, children, wealth and blessings.

variants.text: ॐ ग्रां ग्रीं ग्रौं सः गुरवे नमः
variants.translit: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Jupiter, salutations to Guru.

variants.text:
देवानां च ऋषीणां च गुरुं काञ्चनसन्निभम् ।
बुद्धिभूतं त्रिलोकेशं तं नमामि बृहस्पतिम् ॥
variants.translit:
Devanam cha rishinam cha gurum kanchana sannibham
Buddhi bhutam trilokesham tam namami brihaspatim
variants.meaning: I bow to Brihaspati, teacher of the gods and sages, golden in colour, wisdom itself, lord of the three worlds.

shukra.name: Shukra
shukra.hook: Relationship strain? Life feels dull and joyless?
shukra.about: Shukra rules love, marriage, comforts, beauty and the arts.

variants.text: ॐ द्रां द्रीं द्रौं सः शुक्राय नमः
variants.translit: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Venus, salutations to Shukra.

variants.text:
हिमकुन्दमृणालाभं दैत्यानां परमं गुरुम् ।
सर्वशास्त्रप्रवक्तारं भार्गवं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
variants.translit:
Hima kunda mrinalabham daityanam paramam gurum
Sarva shastra pravaktaram bhargavam pranamamyaham
variants.meaning: I bow to Shukra, white as snow, jasmine and the lotus stalk, the great teacher of the Daityas, who explains all the scriptures.

shani.name: Shani

tool.label: Check if Sade Sati is running for you

shani.hook: Sade Sati? Delays at every step, however hard you try?
shani.about: Shani rules karma, discipline, delays, hard work and justice.

variants.text: ॐ प्रां प्रीं प्रौं सः शनैश्चराय नमः
variants.translit: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaishcharaya Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Saturn, salutations to Shanaishchara, the slow-moving one.

variants.text:
नीलाञ्जनसमाभासं रविपुत्रं यमाग्रजम् ।
छायामार्तण्डसम्भूतं तं नमामि शनैश्चरम् ॥
variants.translit:
Nilanjana samabhasam ravi putram yamagrajam
Chhaya martanda sambhutam tam namami shanaishcharam
variants.meaning: I bow to Shani, dark like blue kohl, son of the Sun and elder brother of Yama, born of Chhaya and Surya.

rahu.name: Rahu
rahu.hook: Confusion, sudden setbacks, running Rahu dasha?
rahu.about: Rahu rules obsession, illusion, foreign lands and sudden events.

variants.text: ॐ भ्रां भ्रीं भ्रौं सः राहवे नमः
variants.translit: Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Rahu, salutations to Rahu.

variants.text:
अर्धकायं महावीर्यं चन्द्रादित्यविमर्दनम् ।
सिंहिकागर्भसम्भूतं तं राहुं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
variants.translit:
Ardhakayam mahaviryam chandraditya vimardanam
Simhika garbha sambhutam tam rahum pranamamyaham
variants.meaning: I bow to Rahu, the half-bodied one of great strength, who eclipses the Moon and the Sun, born of Simhika.

ketu.name: Ketu
ketu.hook: Feeling lost, detached, nothing seems to stick?
ketu.about: Ketu rules detachment, past karma, intuition and moksha.

variants.text: ॐ स्रां स्रीं स्रौं सः केतवे नमः
variants.translit: Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah
variants.meaning: Om, with the seed sounds of Ketu, salutations to Ketu.

variants.text:
पलाशपुष्पसंकाशं तारकाग्रहमस्तकम् ।
रौद्रं रौद्रात्मकं घोरं तं केतुं प्रणमाम्यहम् ॥
variants.translit:
Palasha pushpa sankasham taraka graha mastakam
Raudram raudratmakam ghoram tam ketum pranamamyaham
variants.meaning: I bow to Ketu, red like the palasha flower, head of the stars and planets, fierce and formidable.

_rotation_note: Saturday cycles through Shani, Rahu, Shani, Ketu so the shadow planets get a day too. Variants alternate week by week.

Dhanteras.hook: Dhanteras is on {date}. Before you buy gold or utensils, start with this.
Dhanteras.about: Dhanteras honours Dhanvantari, the physician of the gods, who rose from the churning of the ocean with the pot of amrit.
Dhanteras.meaning: Om, salutations to Dhanvantari, giver of health.
Dhanteras.cta: Dhanteras puja muhurat and timings for your city

Diwali (Lakshmi Puja).hook: Diwali is on {date}. Light the diya and chant this during Lakshmi Puja.
Diwali (Lakshmi Puja).about: On Kartika Amavasya, Goddess Lakshmi is worshipped at Pradosh kaal for wealth, peace and prosperity in the home.
Diwali (Lakshmi Puja).meaning: Om, with the seed sound Shreem, salutations to Mahalakshmi.
Diwali (Lakshmi Puja).cta: Lakshmi Puja muhurat for your city

Chhath Puja.hook: Chhath Puja is on {date}. Offer arghya to the setting Sun with this verse.
Chhath Puja.about: Chhath honours Surya and Chhathi Maiya, with arghya offered to the setting and rising Sun.
Chhath Puja.text:
जपाकुसुमसंकाशं काश्यपेयं महाद्युतिम् ।
तमोऽरिं सर्वपापघ्नं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम् ॥
Chhath Puja.translit:
Japakusuma sankasham kashyapeyam mahadyutim
Tamorim sarvapapaghnam pranato'smi divakaram
Chhath Puja.meaning: I bow to the Sun, red like the hibiscus flower, son of Kashyapa, of great radiance, the enemy of darkness who destroys all sins.
Chhath Puja.cta: Chhath sunset and sunrise arghya timings for your city

Kartik Purnima.about: On Kartika Purnima, devotees take a holy dip, light lamps and worship Shiva, who defeated Tripurasura on this day.
Kartik Purnima.cta: Kartik Purnima timings for your city
